interpretation: The selected ATAC-plus-MegaMap rE2G model has a clean content chronology: its exact Git blob predates all three project sources. Its scientific output is still only an unsigned enhancer-gene link probability. GSE296875 can supply development liver ATAC features, but GSE289173 supplies no ATAC, so sealed use is limited to a static precommitted link atlas. rE2G can compete on retrieval or enter a composite; it cannot win the primary signed-effect endpoint alone.
known_incidents_and_biases: The official application calls pickle.load on model.pkl; benchmark runs must never execute that path.
The official application replaces every NaN and infinity with zero, which conflates structural missingness with observed zero under the project contract.
The selected classifier was trained on K562 CRISPR data, while liver cell states and donor ATAC are a domain transfer.
The 0.179 threshold is chosen for a K562 CRISPR recall operating point and is not calibrated to liver.
The selected feature set depends on upstream ABC candidate peaks, qnorm, gene/TSS definitions, MegaMap contact, and neighborhood features, so leakage can enter before the logistic model.
The registered application revision and ABC submodule postdate some project releases, although the exact fitted model blob is unchanged from 2024.
remaining_blockers: Obtain campaign approval before acquiring model.pkl, then verify Git blob identity, compute SHA-256, statically audit pickle opcodes/globals, and perform a one-time no-network restricted conversion to non-executable numeric coefficients and metadata.
Prove converted-adapter predictions match scikit-learn 1.2.1 on a fixed finite complete-feature fixture before deleting pickle access from the runtime path.
Audit and hash the exact MegaMap contact artifact and its terms; no pretrained power-law rE2G model is available upstream.
Activate GSE296875 only after donor/barcode/well, fragments, peaks, reference, QC, missingness, and rights authorities pass.
Freeze the GENCODE v49 to upstream RefSeq/TSS/promoter-feature crosswalk and reject unresolved genes rather than filling them with zero.
Freeze all donor-by-cell-state features, candidate elements, merged LD blocks, continuous scores, and the final static link atlas before sealed variants are opened.
Keep any allele-specific activity and signed direction model separately named; do not call the composite rE2G alone.
